signed_payload:
[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 120
- Description: Got this repository up and running so that future LLMs on other machines can easily come up to speed on context to handle various tasks within our DAO ecoystem
  
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context
  
  Basically human getting AIs to teach AIs so that humans dont need to teach again
  
  Started experimenting with the following come online based LLMs as opposed to cursor AI for eventual deployment to the cloud
  
  - Gemini CLI
  - ⁠Grok CLI
  - ⁠Claude CLI
  - ⁠Codex CLI
  
  Spent some time thinking through the architecture of how other RAG (_Retreival Augmentation Generation_) infrastructure have been set up 
  
  My sense is instead of incurring a bunch of server cost setting up a vector space database which we don’t really need at our scale as well as the simplicity of what we are doing 
  
  Pre-compile all our DAO’s knowledge based data as vectors and index them as flat files. 
  
  When we need the LLM to make specialized decisions within our context, just have one of the servers convert a query that is being passed in by the user into a vector and do a Euclidean comparison of the query versus all the other factors in the index files to retrieve the right contacts and then pass them to LLM we are utilizing to get the final result to return to the user.
  
  And if the data size becomes a little larger, we just shove the pre-compound vectors into an SQL light database, which is due a flat file that can be easily ported from one server to another. 
  
  Recurring modes of usage that I can think of 
  
  - on boarding of new prospective members
  - ⁠ existing members who wants to get caught up on what has happened in the DAO recently
  - ⁠ freight and shipping configurations
  - ⁠ production cost optimization configurations
  - ⁠ go to market and store outreach strategy
  - ⁠ stores re-stocking strategy
  - ⁠ social media content, marketing ongoing efforts and strategy
  
  My sense is once the stack is implemented. I got to spend less time on all this stuff that requires a lot of logic and just kinda mechanical and perhaps repetitive. 
  
  Instead spend more time on face-to-face interactions for business development and trust building purposes.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 200.00
- Attached Filename: None
- Destination Contribution File Location: No file attached
